title: Onboard Orion-Zeta 13B v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Avery Chen
description: Adds Orion-Zeta 13B v1.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, validated performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets, and automation to include generated release notes in the model changelog. Motivation: Orion-Zeta is a high-throughput 13B variant that we plan to expose via Redwood API and Dedicated pools. We need standardized metadata (licenses, tokenizer, supported precisions), robust perf profiles to drive serving kernel selection and batching heuristics, and automated changelog entries so releases are discoverable by customers and linked to rollout automation. What this PR does: 1) metadata: introduces models/orion-zeta/metadata.json containing model identifiers, license, tokenizer info, supported precisions (fp16, int8), recommended kv-cache behavior, and canonical example prompts. 2) perf profiles: adds models/orion-zeta/perf_profiles.json with p50/p95 latency and throughput numbers across sequence length buckets (128/512/2048) measured on our standard A100-40G and H100 test beds; includes calibration heuristics used by the serving scheduler. 3) changelog automation: wires the existing scripts/changelog-gen.py to pick up new perf_profiles.json metadata and append a generated changelog entry under docs/model-changelogs/orion-zeta.md; adds CI validation to ensure new models include required fields and perf profiles pass sanity checks. 4) tests and docs: adds unit tests for metadata validation and a short docs entry in docs/models.md. Backwards compatibility: profiles are additive and fall back to generic profiles if omitted. Rollout plan: merge to main, trigger registry sync job and automated changelog commit (dry-run passed), and coordinate with runtime team for staged traffic.
